name: atlas-finance-game
description: Distressed-corporate turnaround simulator merging Merton distance-to-default, Altman Z-score and Bayesian lender belief into a 12-quarter decision engine. Python · Streamlit · Plotly.

paragraphs: Adversarial Turnaround under Liquidity And Sovereign-stress. A 12-quarter, gamified corporate-distress simulator. You play the Chief Restructuring Officer of Albion Industrial PLC — a UK mid-cap industrial firm at BB / Negative Outlook with one covenant breach already on the tape.
This is not a stock tracker, not a textbook DCF, and not a budget app. It is an interactive decision engine that fuses three pieces of corporate-finance theory that rarely sit on the same canvas:

Layered on top is an Eisenberg-Noe-style supply-chain contagion module — when sovereign or supplier shocks occur, the probability of follow-on shocks in linked countries is re-weighted upward, so distress propagates non-linearly through the network.
features: Merton structural credit risk — the canonical distance-to-default model from option pricing theory, used here to price the firm's own default probability quarter-by-quarter.
Altman Z'' bankruptcy prediction — applied each quarter as an independent insolvency thermometer.
